Title: Foundations: how the web page loads
Why: Understanding the path from URL to pixels explains most performance and debugging work.

Steps.Text: Read how browsers turn HTML, CSS and JavaScript into a rendered page.
Open DevTools' Network panel on a site you use and read the waterfall.
Learn what the DOM is and change a page from the console.

Title: Modern JavaScript and TypeScript
Why: Promises, modules and types are the everyday tools of front-end work.

Steps.Text: Work through promises and async/await until error handling feels natural.
Learn ES modules, then see how a bundler uses them.
Add TypeScript to a small project with `strict` on.

Title: Fast, safe, accessible sites
Why: Performance and security are features: measure them, then keep them from regressing.

Steps.Text: Learn Core Web Vitals and test one of your pages.
Add a Content Security Policy in report-only mode and read what it reports.
Understand CORS well enough to debug any error message.
